content.body: 👋 Hello all -- I'm trying to carve out some time to get tests written for thenable curtailment. I did have a couple questions though. 1) So for thenable-curtailment we'll need a host-defined function (because there's no scripted exposure today) -- this means for features.txt we'd add the feature both for the helper & the feature; or because the only way to test this is with the helper do we skip naming it in the features.txt 2) Are test plans mandatory or just strongly suggested?
